config.aerogelvk.title: AerogelVK Settings
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.hiZOcclusionEna: Enables GPU Hi-Z depth pyramid occlusion culling (applied immediately).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.vanillaLighting: Replaces deferred PBR, CSM shadows, and SSR with simple Lambert + lightmap shading for low-end GPUs (applied immediately).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.ssrEnabled: Enables screen-space reflections in the built-in deferred PBR pipeline (applied immediately).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.fxaaEnabled: Enables fast approximate anti-aliasing in post-composite (applied immediately).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.csmEnabled: Enables cascaded shadow mapping in the built-in pipeline (applied immediately).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.csmCascades: Number of active shadow cascades (1 - 3, applied immediately).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.csmUpdateInterv: Frame interval for staggered outer cascade updates (1 - 30, applied immediately).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.fastShadowPcf: Uses faster 4-tap PCF shadow filtering instead of full 9-tap PCF (applied immediately).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.shadowSkipStati: Reuses the previous frame's shadow maps when camera, sun, and scene are static (applied immediately).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.csmResolution: Shadow map resolution clamped to 512 / 1024 / 2048. Restart required to reallocate shadow textures.
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.shaderPackEnabl: Enables OptiFine/Iris shaderpack execution on Vulkan (applied immediately).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.shaderPack: Shaderpack filename/folder, 'auto', or 'off' (applied immediately on save).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.shaderPackRende: Internal resolution scale for shaderpack gbuffer/deferred/composite passes (50% - 100%, upscaled in final pass).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.shaderPackShado: Caps shaderpack shadowMapResolution (0 = use pack default, or 256 - 8192).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.sodiumCompatEna: Bypasses Sodium GL terrain draws when AerogelVK renders terrain (applied immediately).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.irisCompatEnabl: Yields terrain rendering to Iris when an external Iris shaderpack is active (applied immediately).
config.aerogelvk.tooltip.dhCompatEnabled: Enables Distant Horizons LOD interop. Note: enabling from a disabled startup state requires restart.
